authorAbout.ko: 준상은 한국어 교사입니다. 약 2년 동안 약 100명의 학생에게 1,700시간이 넘게 한국어를 가르쳤고, 주로 유럽과 미국의 학생들을 만났습니다. 한국어를 가르치는 웹사이트 everykoreans.com 을 운영합니다.
authorAbout.en: Junsang is a Korean teacher. In about two years he has taught around 100 students for more than 1,700 hours, mostly from Europe and the United States. He runs everykoreans.com, a website for learning Korean.

en: These are the 1,000 words that appear most often in the TOPIK II word list we use on everykoreans.com, arranged from level 3 to level 6. Each unit has 20 words, an example sentence for each, and short writing practice.
Read the table aloud, then cover the English and test yourself. Write your answers on the lines, check the answer key at the back, and come back a few days later.
You do not have to memorize 1,000 words in one go. One unit a day is a calm pace: 50 units, about seven weeks.

rows: 對象 target or research subject (조사 대상 survey subjects) vs 大賞 grand prize (연기 대상 grand acting award). Different hanja roots sharing the exact same spelling.
Both mean cost, but 비용 is overall expenditure for an activity or project (여행 비용 travel costs), while 요금 is a fixed rate for using a service (버스 요금 bus fare).
Sound identical in isolation ([빋]). 빛 means optical light or glow (햇빛 sunlight), whereas 빚 means financial debt (빚을 갚다 to pay off debt).

items.q: 지속적인 대화와 타협을 통해 양측은 ___ 원만한 합의에 이르렀다.

items.q: 온라인 간편 결제는 현대 소비자들의 주요 결제 ___으로 자리 잡았다.

items.q: 유아기에는 신체와 정서의 균형 있는 ___이 중요하다.

rows: 상태 refers to the physical or mental condition of a person or object (건강 상태 health condition). 상황 refers to external circumstances or surroundings (경제 상황 economic situation).
Both mean to increase, but 높이다 raises grade, level, or quality (가치를 높이다 to raise value), while 늘리다 increases volume, count, or duration (생산량을 늘리다 to increase output).
構造 organization or framework (건물의 구조 building structure) vs 救助 rescue or relief from danger (조난자 구조 rescuing a stranded person). Context determines the meaning.

rows: 修理 physical repair or fixing (기계 수리 machine repair) vs 受理 formal acceptance and processing of an application (서류 수리 document acceptance). Unrelated hanja roots.

Both are about a thought coming to mind. 떠오르다 is an idea or image that rises in the mind (좋은 생각이 떠오르다 a good idea comes to mind). 생각나다 is something you already knew coming back to you (단어가 생각나다 the word comes to mind).
외부 denotes the exterior side of a boundary or outside an organization (외부 시선 outside perspective). 실외 specifically refers to the open air outdoors, opposite of 실내 (실외 수영장).

items.q: 위생 관리를 위해 조리되지 않은 ___을 실온에 오래 방치해서는 안 된다.

rows: 時刻 point in time or clock time (도착 시각 arrival time) vs 視覺 visual sense (시각 장애 visual impairment) vs 視角 viewpoint or perspective (새로운 시각 fresh perspective).
洗劑 detergent or cleaning chemical (세탁 세제 laundry detergent) vs 稅制 national tax policy system (세제 혜택 tax benefit). Context makes the distinction obvious.
Both can mean to select or adopt, but 취하다 is formal and abstract (적절한 조치를 취하다 to take proper action), while 고르다 is everyday physical selection (선물을 고르다).

rows: Commonly confused homophones. 決濟 결제 is financial settlement or paying money (카드 결제 card payment). 決裁 결재 is approval from a workplace superior (서류 결재 document approval).

가리다 ① to shield or conceal from sight (얼굴을 가리다 to cover a face). 가리다 ② to distinguish right from wrong or be finicky (시비를 가리다, 음식을 가리다 to be a picky eater).

rows: Both relate to future events, but 예정 emphasizes an expected schedule or timetable (도착 예정 시간 estimated arrival time), while 계획 focuses on active planning and intentions (사업 계획 business plan).
수수료 is a handling fee or commission charged for a specific transactional service (송금 수수료 transfer fee). 비용 is a broader term for total expenses incurred (생활 비용 living expenses).
Both set numerical cutoffs that include the stated number itself. 이하 means that number or below (18세 이하 18 or younger), while 이상 means that number or above (20세 이상 20 or older).

rows: Two distinct native usages: 잠기다 ① to be locked or closed tightly (문이 잠기다 the door is locked) vs 잠기다 ② to be submerged under liquid or lost in thought (물에 잠기다, 생각에 잠기다).

rows: Frequently confused spellings with similar pronunciation. 낳다 [나타] means to give birth or yield results (아이를 낳다). 낫다 [낟따] means to recover from illness or be better (감기가 낫다).
Both mean supplying, but 제공 focuses on offering services or convenience to users (정보 제공 providing info), while 공급 focuses on macro distribution of commodities or utilities (물 공급 water supply).
당기다 means pulling something toward one body (손잡이를 당기다 to pull a handle). 끌다 involves dragging an object along or drawing abstract attention (주의를 끌다 to draw attention).

rows: Two distinct native Korean verbs: 말리다 ① to dry wet items (빨래를 말리다 to dry laundry) vs 말리다 ② to stop a dispute or dissuade someone (친구의 싸움을 말리다 to stop a fight).
Both sound similar ([개발]). 開發 개발 is developing external resources, products, or software (소프트웨어 개발). 啓發 계발 is developing inner human potential and talents (자기계발 self-improvement).
목적 is the overarching purpose or why behind an action (방문 목적 purpose of visit). 목표 is a specific, measurable target or milestone to hit (매출 목표 sales target).

rows: 낮추다 lowers a level, height, or intensity along a vertical scale (온도를 낮추다 to lower temperature). 줄이다 reduces numerical amount, physical size, or quantity (지출을 줄이다 to cut expenses).
시절 describes a nostalgic or personal phase of life (학창 시절 school days). 시대 refers to a broad historical epoch or social era (조선 시대 the Joseon era, 스마트폰 시대 the smartphone age).
資源 natural or economic resources (천연자원 natural resources) vs 自願 voluntary action by one's own choice (자원봉사 volunteer service). Unrelated hanja roots.

rows: 日時 date and hour of an appointment (행사 일시 event date and time) vs 一時 temporary or one-time occurrence (일시 정지 temporary pause). Note the difference between noun and modifier.

Both mean to experience, but 겪다 strongly leans toward enduring hardships, pain, or challenges (어려움을 겪다 to undergo difficulty). 경험하다 is neutral and versatile (한국 문화를 경험하다).

rows: 壽命 lifespan of a person or device (평균 수명 life expectancy, 부품 수명 part lifespan) vs 數名 several people (수명이 모였다 several people gathered). Distinct hanja roots.

rows: Frequently confused spellings with similar pronunciation. 바치다 means dedicating or offering up devotion (청춘을 바치다). 받치다 means supporting from below (턱을 받치다 to rest one's chin on hands).
보상 is compensation for lawful losses or rewards for sacrifice (적절한 보상 fair compensation). 배상 is legal damages paid for unlawful injury or wrongdoing (손해 배상 liability damages).
Both mean gaze or attention, but 시선 often carries social pressure or critical awareness (사람들의 시선 social gaze), while 눈길 feels more immediate, sensory, and warm (따뜻한 눈길 a warm glance).

rows: Key philosophical pair in TOPIK. 객관적 relies on verifiable data and facts (객관적인 평가 objective assessment), while 주관적 reflects personal feelings and views (주관적인 판단 subjective judgment).

Both mean restoration, but 복원 focuses on returning cultural artifacts or nature to original historic form (유적지 복원). 복구 focuses on repairing storm damage or computer crashes back to operation (전산망 복구).

ko: 어릴 때부터 국어는 문법부터 배우는 어려운 과목이었고, 수능을 준비하면서는 더욱 어렵다고만 생각했습니다. 그런 제가 대학교에 다니던 중, 한국어 선생님을 하는 친구를 보고 "나도 한번 해 볼까" 하는 마음으로 도전하게 되었습니다.
처음에는 학생이 한 명도 없었습니다. 말 그대로 파리만 날렸습니다. 그러던 어느 날 제 계정으로 알림이 왔습니다. 한 학생이 수업을 예약했다는 소식이었습니다. 그때부터 가슴이 뛰기 시작했고, 그 학생을 위해 자료를 준비하는 일이 설렜습니다. 어쩌면 그때부터 한국어를 가르치는 일에 빠졌는지도 모르겠습니다.
재미로, 아르바이트처럼 시작한 일이 2년을 넘었습니다. 그동안 1,700시간이 넘게, 100명의 학생을 가르쳤습니다. 전 세계의 학생들을 만났고, 주로 유럽과 미국의 학생들을 가르쳤습니다.
가르치다 보면 설명이 안 돼서 답답할 만큼 아름다운 한국어를 만납니다. 그런 한국어를 가르칠 수 있다는 것이 저는 축복이라고 느낍니다. 지금은 한국어를 더 널리 알리기 위해 한국어를 가르치는 웹사이트 everykoreans.com 을 운영하고 있고, 대학교 공부도 함께 하고 있습니다.
en: I became a Korean teacher by accident.

Ever since I was a child, Korean class meant learning grammar first, and I thought of it as a hard subject, even more so while preparing for the national college entrance exam. While I was still in university, I saw a friend teaching Korean and thought, "Why not give it a try?"

At first I had no students at all. Truly, not a soul. Then one day a notification arrived on my account: a student had booked a lesson. My heart started to race, and I felt a thrill preparing materials for that student. Maybe that was the moment I fell for teaching Korean.

What began as a fun side job has now lasted more than two years. In that time I have taught over 1,700 hours to 100 students. I have taught students from all over the world, mostly from Europe and the United States.

When you teach Korean, you sometimes meet a beauty so deep that it frustrates you because you cannot explain it. I feel blessed to be able to teach that Korean. Today I run everykoreans.com, a website for learning Korean, to spread Korean further, and I am studying at university at the same time.
